title: Inventory
description: The inventory of a module's package, inventory.json (section 25 of the format text): the module's format version, ID and version, and the digest and size of each of the package's two parts — the server part, which is the canonical view, and the device part, which a listing of its files names. The digest of the package is the digest of its inventory.

module_format_version.description: The format version that the module's manifest names, by which the package is read. It stands at the root of the inventory in every version of the format, so that a reader finds it before it knows how to read the rest.

id.description: The module's ID, as its manifest names it.

version.description: The module's version, as its manifest names it.

server_part.description: The server part, server.json: the canonical text of the canonical view.

device_part.description: The device part, by its listing, device.json: the canonical text of the listing of its files.

digest.description: A digest: sha256: and the SHA-256 of the bytes, in 64 lowercase hexadecimal digits.

descriptor.description: What names bytes of a package: their digest and their size.

license.description: LICENSE, the text of the module's license.

notice.description: NOTICE, the notices of the licenses, when the module has one.

additionalProperties.description: A media file, by its path from media/.

media.description: The files of media/, when the module has any, each by its path from media/.

device_listing.description: The listing of a package's device part, device.json: every file of it, each named by its digest and size.
